# Orbyss.Foundation.Identity.Admin.Abstractions

Provider-neutral contracts for identity administration from application workflows. The contracts
cover portable concepts such as users, applications, scopes, roles, groups, credentials,
enrollment actions, and sessions. Install an identity-provider adapter to implement only the
subdomains a shell needs.
